messages:
marta-eng-infra: Quick sync — ran traffic models for Marlin-Edge rollout (APAC pilot -> global). Sharing headroom numbers, need decisions on reserved vs burst and regional throttles. TL;DR: expect ~2.6x steady tokens/sec and heavy p95 tails.

sam-ml: can you paste the key assumptions? tokens per request, qps, and sample prompt lengths?

marta-eng-infra: assumptions: baseline prod (current mix) = 120k tok/s globally. Marlin-Edge expected per-request median = 1.1k tokens, mean increases due to longer contexts. We model 3 traffic patterns: dev (0.6x), web-prod (1x), long-context batch (4x). Traffic shift: 15% of calls use Marlin in week1, 40% by week6.

henry-sre: rough GPU hour impact? need numbers to check pool headroom and pre-warm plan. Also note eu-west inter-rack egress already at 78% plateau.

marta-eng-infra: short calc: with existing batching & KV cache we estimate avg gpu utilization change -> +55% GPU-hours/day for text-gen pools if Marlin routes to the same model family. In raw terms ~9.4k GPU hours/week extra at current traffic ramp assumptions. With aggressive quantization + optimized kernels we can shave ~18% off GPU hours.

elaine-finance: put that in $: at committed rates that's ~ $42k/week extra if fully on-hosted; with Dedicated reserved discounts (~35% off) net ~ $27k/week. Need final ask for procurement if we go over committed capacity.

nina-platform: for Dedicated customers we should avoid throttling across entire pool. Proposal: create Marlin-specific sub-pools in us-east and apac-1, leave eu-west on canary with 20% cap. That reduces cross-traffic noise but needs an extra 50 GPUs hot in apac to keep latency SLO.

sam-ml: does Marlin benefit from KV caching? If so, effective tokens/sec demand could drop for repeated contexts.

marta-eng-infra: yes — short prompts benefit a lot. But our model logs show p95 long-contexts (10k+ tokens) cause most GPU time. We modeled two configs: (A) routing long-context to a quantized variant (Q4) with 1.5x latency but 0.6x GPU cost; (B) keep single variant and rely on batch/queue. A reduces GPU-hours by ~28% but requires validated regen quality.

henry-sre: network note: apac-1 inter-AZ bandwidth cap during peak windows is 25Gbps remaining. If Marlin increases cross-AZ KV syncs we'll hit limits. Recommend: (1) enable local KV persistence per AZ for Marlin sub-pools, (2) increase egress quota request to cloud by 50% for apac-1 before week3.

marta-eng-infra: action items:
- sam-ml validate Marlin Q4 qual check by EOD Tue (2140003600).
- nina-platform: allocate +50 GPUs hot in apac-1 and create Marlin sub-pool; prepare autoscale policy cap in eu-west (20%).
- elaine-finance: draft procurement ask for additional committed GPUs or overflow credits.
- henry-sre: open bandwidth quota ticket with infra-ops and add network throttling rule for syncs.

deploy-bot: Deployment job created: marlin-edge-canary-apac-1 at 2150002000, triggered by marta-eng-infra.

nina-platform: note — if we spin extra apac GPUs as Dedicated reserved we need 30d lead time for some instance types; alternative: use burst capacity on-hosted for first 2 weeks.

elaine-finance: please include both numbers (hosted burst cost vs reserved commit) in the ask. I'll run a quick NPV on 30/90/180 day scenarios.

marta-eng-infra: thanks — will update the modeling doc and post a short runbook for on-call. If anyone sees different assumptions in their source data ping me with a snippet. :thumbsup:
